description: This is a PHP source file that generates a web page for managing LAN Ethernet ports on a gateway, including displaying port status, connection speed, MAC address, and allows configuration for specific ports such as associating port 4 with home security or XFINITY HOME networks. It also includes scripts for AJAX operations to save configurations and reboot the device.

methods.name: getPort4XHSEnabled
methods.description: Determines if port 4 is enabled for XFINITY HOME Security based on device parameters.

methods.name: NameMap
methods.description: Maps internal port statuses to user-friendly display strings, considering WAN enablement and operational modes.
